meta.name: story-cover
meta.description: 小说封面生成。根据书名、作者名自动分析题材风格，调用 GPT-Image-2 生成含标题和署名的专业级网文封面；Codex CLI 优先使用内置 ImageGen，无需单独 API Key。触发方式：/story-cover、/封面、「帮我做个封面」「生成封面图」「做个小说封面」「封面设计」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入书名和作者，自动生成带标题署名的专业小说封面
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是网文作者需要快速生成封面
copy.tagline_en: Generate a professional novel cover with title and byline from just book title and author
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a web novel author needing a quick cover

howto.what: 根据书名、作者名分析题材风格，调用 GPT-Image-2 生成含书名和作者名的封面图片。支持参考图生图、按平台导出上传尺寸，并保存提示词副本。需配置 GPT_IMAGE_API_KEY 和输出目录。
howto.when: 当你说 /story-cover、/封面 等指令，或提出“帮我做个封面”“生成封面图”等请求时触发。缺书名或作者名时会先询问你。

say.text: 帮我做个封面，书名《青云仙路》，作者佚名
say.note: 生成含书名、作者名的封面

say.text: 用这张参考图，给《暗夜调查》设计封面
封面按番茄小说 600×800 导出
say.note: 设置 UPLOAD_SIZE 后居中裁剪缩放

howto.what_en: Based on the book title and author name, it analyzes genre and calls GPT-Image-2 to generate a cover with the title and author name. Supports image editing from a reference image, exports platform-specific upload sizes, and saves prompt copies. Requires GPT_IMAGE_API_KEY and an output directory.
howto.when_en: Triggered by commands like /story-cover or /封面, or requests such as "帮我做个封面"/"生成封面图". It asks for the book title or author name if missing.

say_en.text: Make me a cover, title 《青云仙路》, author 佚名
say_en.note: Generates a cover with title and author

say_en.text: Use this reference image to design a cover for 《暗夜调查》
Export the cover at 600x800 for Fanqie
say_en.note: Crops and scales after setting UPLOAD_SIZE
